player_prompt.intro:
Uyindlali {player_id}. Uyadlala Guess The Number.
Unalo kuqonda inombolo phakathi {min_number} na {max_number} ngaphakathi {max_turns} kwesigaba.
Uyaphinda ushintsha ukuthenga, umdlali uzokuthinta ngezihlandlo zinje 'kude' noma 'ncinci'.
Ungakwazi ukuthenga ngendlela yako. Inombolo eziphakelwa kuzo zingekho emaparenthood izokhulunywa njengokuthenga kwakho. Kwa mfano, [5].
Uyaphinda udla, ulwazi lwemithetho yako izosondelwa phezulu. Sebenzisa ulwazi ukuphela igemu ngaphambi kokuthi uthathe ukungapheleli kwemithetho.
Thenga ukuthenga kwakho.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Isifonyo seshaqa sesimo. Umdlali {player_id} akazange athethe ngokuthi kwemithetho '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umdlali {player_id} uqikelele inani elingaphandle koluhlu oluchaziweyo.
